metadata.description: The Claude Code plugin of the codex-mcp server, released from the server's own repository.

plugins.name: codex-mcp
plugins.description: Runs OpenAI Codex from Claude Code: the codex-mcp server, a codex subagent that proxies one prompt to Codex and reports the turn's progress and answer, and a hook that keeps the Codex tools inside that subagent.
